newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 1.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

St George shares rose sharply on Thursday with speculation that National Australia Bank Ltd was behind the buying in a move to scuttle the bank's A$2.65 billion takeover of Advance Bank Australia Ltd. The Australian Stock Exchange on Thursday gave St George approval to proceed with its bid without first calling a shareholder meeting.
The property and financial services group announced late on Thursday at its annual meeting that it expected to increase net profit in the current financial year.
Shares in the Papua New Guinean government's resources group make their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange today. The PNG government set a final institutional sale price of A$2.00 on Thursday.
Annual meetings are being held today by the above companies.

September monthly and quarterly retail sales data due out at 0030 GMT (11.30 a.m.), will give indication of first quarter trading conditions of major retailers. The September quarter sales seen rising 1.3 percent in a big turnaround from the 0.6 percent fall in the June quarter.
